jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Dunder Mifflin's platform team runs the infrastructure behind our online paper ordering. This role is fully remote within Canada.

What you'll do

  • Write Go services for internal platform tooling
  • Containerize workloads with Docker and run them on Kubernetes
  • Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines

Requirements

  • Go
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • CI/CD

Remote (Canada). We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Write firmware for Dunder Mifflin's warehouse sorting machines.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering
  • C and embedded Linux
  • Must hold a P.Eng. designation with APEGA

Onsite in Calgary. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.

jobs.title: QA Automation Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Automate testing for Dunder Mifflin's ordering platform. This is a 12-month contract.

Responsibilities

  • Write automated API and UI tests
  • Run the test suites in CI/CD

Requirements

  • Python
  • pytest
  • Selenium or Playwright
  • CI/CD

Onsite in Montreal. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.
